info.title: B&B Unikoop API
info.summary: Products, catalog data and the assistant for the B&B Unikoop website.

get.description:
Readiness: the API and its database both answer. The keep-alive cron calls this, which also keeps the
Supabase free project from pausing after 7 idle days.

Liveness: the process answers, without touching the database. Render's health check uses this, so a
database outage doesn't make Render restart or refuse to deploy the API.

Catalog search. Without `sort`, results are ranked: exact designation, prefix, contains, dimension match,
word match; then natural designation order. A page past the end returns the last page (see `meta.page`).

get.description: Slugs in catalog order with their last import time, one sitemap file at a time.
Same type, closest bore diameter first.
Products used in an industry, B&B Unikoop's own picks first. An unknown industry has none.

SKF technical data: load ratings, speeds, mass, calculation factors and the full data sheet.
404 `specs_not_found` when the product has none: link to `https://www.skf.com` instead of guessing values.

404.description: No technical data for this product (yet)

get.description: Splits an SKF designation (6205-2RSH/C3, 22212 EK, NU 208 ECP) into prefix, series, bore code and suffixes.

ISO 281 basic rating life L10 and the life at a higher reliability (a1), for a catalog product or a given C.
Loads in kN. Errors: `rating_life_unsupported` (not a rolling bearing), `load_case_unsupported` (e.g. an axial
load without SKF factors).

422.description: Invalid fields, or a case the formulas don't cover (`load_case_unsupported`, ...)

get.description:
SKF's simplified grease relubrication interval and replenishment quantity. Errors: `relubrication_unsupported`,
`relubrication_out_of_range` (too fast for grease).

422.description: Invalid fields, or a case the formulas don't cover (`load_case_unsupported`, ...)

post.description:
A chat turn, streamed. Starter prompts (`preset`) are answered from catalog data without the model; free
text goes to the model with the catalog tools. Limits: 10 messages per 10 min per client, 2,000 characters.

200.description: JSON Lines: one event per line, ending with `done`

AskEvent.title: AskEvent
AskEvent.description: A scripted flow asks the user for input; the next message answers it.

conversationId.title: Conversationid
conversationId.description: From a previous `done` event; omit to start

preset.title: Preset
preset.description: A starter prompt's flow. With an empty message the flow asks for what it needs

locale.title: Locale
locale.description: Site language; the answer follows the user's

ConfidenceEvent.title: ConfidenceEvent
ConfidenceEvent.description: The model's own rating of its answer. None when the answer is a question back.

ContactEvent.title: ContactEvent
ContactEvent.description: Where to buy: B&B Unikoop's offices, phones, the quote basket and the contact form.

name.title: Name
name.description: SKF's name for the value, e.g. 'Shoulder diameter' (English)

min.title: Min
min.description: For a range, e.g. a tolerance

DecodedDesignation.title: DecodedDesignation
DecodedDesignation.description: An empty `segments` list means nothing could be read (blank or separators only).

id.title: Id
id.description: Meaning key (frontend `Decoder.codes.<id>`); null for unknown parts

boreMm.title: Boremm
boreMm.description: Bore diameter for a bore segment, mm

DoneEvent.title: DoneEvent
DoneEvent.description:
Always the last event of a turn that was saved: keep `conversationId` for the next message and `messageId`
for feedback.

ErrorEvent.title: ErrorEvent
ErrorEvent.description:
assistant_unavailable: no model configured or every model down; assistant_busy: the daily limit is used up;
assistant_failed: the answer broke off; conversation_not_found: start a new one.

temp.title: Temp
temp.description: Temperature level: L, M, H, VH (ranges like 'L–M')

speed.title: Speed

load.title: Load
load.description: Load level: L, M, H, VH

fit.title: Fit

groups.title: Groups
groups.description: Greases in one group behave the same, e.g. 'LGMT 2 · LGMT 3'

Relubrication.title: Relubrication
Relubrication.description:
SKF's simplified relubrication interval for a lithium-base grease. An estimate: conditions like
contamination, water or vibration shorten it.

SpecsEvent.title: SpecsEvent
SpecsEvent.description: A product's data sheet. `specs` is null when SKF data isn't in the catalog yet: link to skf.com.

StatusEvent.title: StatusEvent
StatusEvent.description: What the assistant is doing, until the first text arrives.

TextEvent.title: TextEvent
TextEvent.description: A piece of the model's Markdown answer; append in order.
